data.input: frozen P3 atom/bond/junction objects + structure-only relation arrays between existing junction/bond tokens
data.global33_standardisation: original P3 train-only fit (ad_data norm.json), same for P/R/N
data.new_fitted_statistics: none (relation construction has no fitted parameters)

ssl.note: train-only masked atom/bond reconstruction; no labels; shared source means the seed spread covers supervised training only

model.R: P3 encoders -> one relation update on junction+bond tokens -> original P3 Null composer/reader
model.N: same as R with cached within-molecule within-role-stratum relation-label permutation
model.candidate_pairs: clipped anchor distance <= 3 OR shared biconnected ring block, both directions, self loops rel 0

null.scope: within molecule, within JJ/JB/BB role stratum
null.bidirectional: same permuted label on both directions

recipe.selection: argmin(valid_mae), strict <, ties keep earlier epoch

initialisation.common: P3NullModel encoders/composer/reader constructed under torch.manual_seed(seed); shared by P/R/N
initialisation.p3_ssl_overrides: loaded after construction; atom/bond/junction encoders fine-tuned
initialisation.relation_module: independent generator seed 80261107 + supervised seed; identical for R and N

effect_size_reference.note: reference scale only, not a noise floor or significance threshold

decision.test_trigger: H1 overall supported in both completed supervised seeds and W20/T100 not clearly reversed; test is read once, best-valid is the main table

non_goals: no new dataset, backbone family, SSL objective, width/depth grid or post-processing
no row172 removal or row-specific output
no claim that LayerNorm caused the old HR failure
no claim that preserving SSL plus one attention is itself a novel contribution
